messages:

Subject: Request: strict regional isolation + model assignment for Novafin PII workloads

Marcus —

Thanks again for the demo earlier. Our legal and security teams reviewed Redwood and have a hard requirement for tenant-level isolation for production PII traffic: all inference for Novafin must remain inside eu-west-1, must not failover or fallback to any other region or shared pool, and must be pinned to the quantized 8-bit variant you mentioned (the smaller 7B-like profile) to limit on-disk exposure.

We understand this is an operational exception, so can you confirm:
- whether you can create a regional-only routing assignment for our tenant (no cross-region fallback)
- whether you can hard-assign the specific model variant at routing time and prevent automatic substitution during capacity events
- what the SLA/availability tradeoffs will be (SLO change)
- timeline and any one-time work or costs

I'm looping in our SecOps (secops@novafin.com) — they'll provide the compliance checklist. We need an answer this week to align with procurement.

Best,
Elena Ruiz
Head of Product, Novafin

Subject: RE: Request: strict regional isolation + model assignment for Novafin PII workloads

Team —

Novafin is asking for three hard constraints: regional-only routing (eu-west-1), no fallback to other regions or shared capacity, and a forced model variant at route time (quantized 8-bit). Procurement wants confirmation this week.

High-level questions for product/infra:
1) Can we express a routing policy that is strictly region-local and returns an error rather than failing over when capacity is exhausted?
2) Can we pin a tenant to a model variant and refuse automatic substitution (including smaller/larger or fp16 vs quantized) during rollouts or emergency fallbacks?
3) Operational impact: does this require a dedicated pool or can we satisfy with placement preferences + capacity reservations?
4) What are the expected availability and cost impacts for the customer?

Monica — can you attach the SOW and procurement doc you have from your earlier discussion? Lauren/Karthik — please advise on implementation feasibility and a rough ETA if feasible. I put Novafin's secops on cc for transparency.

Thanks,
Marcus
Account Executive — Redwood Inference

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Elena Ruiz <elena@novafin.com>
Date: 2026-12-01T08:12:00Z
Subject: RE: Request: strict regional isolation + model assignment for Novafin PII workloads

Marcus / Monica —

Short answer: technically possible with caveats. Details below.

What we can offer today (config + infra gap):
- Routing policy: we can create a route that is region-scoped (eu-west-1) and mark other regions as explicit non-fallback. The request would cause requests to fail fast when capacity is insufficient rather than automatically rerouting.
- Model pinning: we can pin a tenant at routing-layer to an explicit model identifier (model: rwd-8b-quant-ew1). However, there are edge-cases during emergency maintenance where our autoscaler could attempt a different compatible host unless we reserve capacity or mark the tenant to run only on dedicated nodes.

Risks / trade-offs:
- Availability: without fallback you lose our cross-region resilience; customers can see higher error rates under load unless we reserve headroom.
- Cost: to guarantee the behavior we need either: (A) reserved capacity (dedicated pool) or (B) aggressive pre-pinning with overprovisioning in eu-west-1. Both increase monthly cost.
- Rollouts: pinned model means we cannot do transparent model upgrades for Novafin; upgrades require coordinated downtime or a canary plan.

Ask from Sec & Sales to proceed:
- Security must approve the KMS and key residency mapping (does Novafin require their own KMS/HSM?).
- Sales/Finance confirm if Novafin accepts a dedicated capacity commitment or wants a best-effort configuration (higher risk).

If the customer is OK with dedicated capacity, we can provide a firm ETA: infra build + policy + testing ~ 3–4 weeks; best-effort with reservations ~ 7–10 business days but with higher error risk.

Lauren Bishop
Director, Product — Redwood Inference

Subject: RE: Request: strict regional isolation + model assignment for Novafin PII workloads

Elena —

Thanks for the clarification and the checklist. Per product: we can meet the ask but there are two commercial paths (pick one):

1) Dedicated capacity (recommended): we provision a dedicated pool in eu-west-1, hard-assign rwd-8b-quant-ew1 for Novafin, and disable cross-region fallback. ETA ~3–4 weeks after contract signature. Requires minimum 3-month committed capacity and KMS integration work.

2) Reservation + preference (lower cost, higher risk): we set strict region preference and pin at routing-layer but do not enforce dedicated nodes. On capacity shortfalls requests will error rather than fallback; ETA ~7–10 business days. Not SLA-backed.

Action items I will drive:
- Monica — finalize SOW language and procurement by EOD Friday.
- Lauren/Karthik — please provide a short internal risk note for Legal & Security describing the operational implications for the choice above (due Tues).
- Elena — confirm which commercial path Novafin prefers and whether they will provide/require BYOK KMS details.

I'll also open a routing-policy request ticket and attach Monica's SOW for tracking.

Thanks,
Marcus
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
